output.tldr: Bajaj Finance demonstrates exceptional execution on growth and profitability targets, though rising debt levels and negative cash flows from operations reflect the capital-intensive nature of its aggressive lending expansion.

promises.promise: Deliver 20% to 24% AUM growth for FY27 aided by new businesses.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show revenue growth of 22.8% in Q2 FY27.
promises.why: Current revenue growth aligns with the guided AUM growth range.

promises.promise: Add 15 to 17 million new customers in FY27.
promises.actual: Added 5 million customers in Q1 FY27 alone; target revised upward.
promises.why: Management now guides for 18-20 million new customers.

promises.promise: Improve opex-to-NTI by 25 to 40 basis points in FY27.
promises.actual: Management remains comfortable delivering this improvement as of Q2 FY27.
promises.why: Guidance reiterated consistently across three consecutive quarters.

promises.promise: MSME business to return to double-digit growth momentum by Q2-Q3 FY27.
promises.actual: Management expects double-digit momentum starting in the second half.
promises.why: Reiterated in Q2 FY27 call as being on track.

promises.promise: Gold loan portfolio to cross 5% of total AUM by FY27.
promises.actual: Gold loan business grew 112% in Q1 FY27.
promises.why: Hyper-growth in this segment supports the 5% AUM target.

promises.promise: Maintain return on equity (ROE) of 19% to 20% in FY27.
promises.actual: Management reported ROE crossed 20% in Q1 FY27.
promises.why: Performance exceeded the upper bound of the guided range.

credibility.line: Management consistently meets or raises guidance, particularly in customer acquisition and AUM growth, showing high predictability and operational control.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management claims strong conviction in secular growth and robust capital position.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show PAT growth of 28.7% in Q2 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Guidance for credit costs to trend down to 145-160 basis points.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show Q3 FY26 PAT fell 5.6% YoY.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Confident in adding 15-17 million customers, later raised to 18-20 million.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Added 5 million customers in Q1 FY27.

bull.point: Strong revenue and profit momentum sustained over long periods.
Aggressive expansion into high-growth segments like gold loans.
Consistent operational efficiency improvements through digital transformation.

bear.point: Significant negative cash flow from operations indicates heavy capital consumption.
Rising leverage and borrowing requirements to fund growth.
Asset quality concerns in specific segments like MSME.

watch_next: MSME growth reaching double digits in H2 FY27.
Impact of regulatory changes on insurance and revolver revenue.
Sustainability of 20%+ ROE amid rising cost of funds.
